title: Natural Sleep Platinum Comfort Mattress
body_html:
Exceptional temperature and motion control
for a wonderful sleep

We use natural latex to make sure nothing stops you from getting the sleep you deserve.

Latex has an amazing range of benefits, preventing allergens or dust mites from aggravating asthma and allergies while you sleep. It also helps you achieve a more restful sleep, regulating your body temperature with its cooling effect.

The durable latex material is also incredibly supportive, moulding to every curve in your body to prevent back pain and give consistent support over time – without the extra cost.

Features & benefits:

  • Soft to medium feel
  • Topped with pure natural latex for ultimate pressure relief
  • 1200 Pocket sprung zoned at the edge for a firmer feel
  • Knitted cloth that stretches two ways, offering increased comfort
  • Non-turn mattress
  • Latex is naturally anti-dust mite material and reduces allergy triggers
  • Latex keeps your body temperature cooler while you sleep
  • Spinal Zone system offers more support at a lower back level

title: Natural Sleep Nature's Touch Mattress
body_html:
Superior organic, natural materials to deliver a quality night’s sleep in a cool environment

The Nature’s Touch Mattress helps you lead an organic and healthier life without compromising on comfort.

The natural layers of lambswool and latex have a range of benefits, from reducing the triggers of asthma and sinusitis in your sleeping environment, to regulating your body temperature for a better night’s rest.

The combination of the foam encased walls and pocket sprung core provides premium orthopedic support, preventing that sinking feeling of being stuck in a mattress. You can avoid aggravating back pain or other medical conditions while you sleep.

Features & benefits:

  • Medium to soft feel / 14 inchs deep
  • Made from lamb’s wool & organic cotton to keep you cool in summer, and warm in winter
  • Foam Encased Construction for superior edge to edge comfort
  • Non-turn mattress
  • Natural Latex offers the ultimate pressure relief
  • 3000 Pocket Sprung to reduce motion disturbance
  • Spinal Zone system offers more support at a lower back level
